changeSet.author: naeem
changeSet.comment: Set supplier_id for existing products based on their warehouse's supplier
changeSet.sql: UPDATE products p SET supplier_id = ( SELECT w.supplier_id FROM warehouses w WHERE w.id = p.warehouse_id ) WHERE p.supplier_id IS NULL AND p.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM warehouses w WHERE w.id = p.warehouse_id AND w.supplier_id IS NOT NULL );
